title: A Funny Comic
text:
Anna has a comic book about a bear. The bear is called Bob. Bob lives in a big forest. Every day, Bob finds a new funny problem. Anna reads the comic book in bed.

On Sunday, Anna goes to the park with her brother. Her brother has a new comic book too. He gives it to Anna. The story is about a fox and a rabbit. Anna wants to read it at home.

questions.text: What is the name of the bear?
Who gives Anna a comic book?
Why does Anna probably like Bob's comics?
Where does Anna probably read comics?

vocabulary.definition: a large area with many trees
a small animal with long ears that hops
a public place with grass and trees where people walk and play
a boy or man who has the same parents as you

paragraph_translations: Anna ma komiks o niedźwiedziu. Niedźwiedź nazywa się Bob. Bob mieszka w dużym lesie. Każdego dnia Bob znajduje nowy, zabawny problem. Anna czyta komiks w łóżku.
W niedzielę Anna idzie do parku ze swoim bratem. Jej brat też ma nowy komiks. Daje go Annie. Historia jest o lisie i króliku. Anna chce go przeczytać w domu.
